nodes.label: Layered Architecture with Dependency Inversion
nodes.description: Modular layered architecture decoupling ORM core from specific database drivers via IDriverAdapter interface

nodes.label: Public API Layer
nodes.description: Facade layer exposing Sequelize, Model, DataTypes, Op, Transaction, Migrator

nodes.label: Core Layer
nodes.description: Sequelize facade, Model (Active Record), QueryBuilder (Fluent API), Dialect/QueryGenerator

nodes.label: Adapter Layer
nodes.description: IDriverAdapter interface abstracting driver operations: connect, pool, execute, transactions

nodes.label: Sequelize (Facade)
nodes.description: Main entry point, manages connections, model registry, transactions

nodes.label: Model (Active Record)
nodes.description: Active Record pattern with Proxy for transparent attribute access

nodes.label: QueryBuilder (Fluent API)
nodes.description: Fluent query builder generating Firebird-optimized SQL

nodes.label: Dialect / QueryGenerator
nodes.description: Firebird SQL generation, version-aware (FB 2.5/3.0/4.0/5.0)

nodes.label: IDriverAdapter (Interface)
nodes.description: Interface abstracting driver operations: connect, createPool, execute, startTransaction, commit/rollback, close

nodes.label: NodeFirebirdAdapter
nodes.description: Implementation of IDriverAdapter using node-firebird driver (pure JS, wire protocol)

nodes.label: Technology Stack Decisions
nodes.description: Driver: node-firebird; Runtime: Node.js ≥ 18 LTS; Target FB: 3.0+ (4.0/5.0 full); Language: JavaScript native (ESM+CJS); Testing: Jest+Docker; Lint: ESLint+Prettier; CI/CD: GitHub Actions

nodes.label: Sequelize-inspired Factory API
nodes.description: Model definition via sequelize.define() factory function, no decorators, JSDoc for typing

nodes.label: 10-Phase Development Roadmap
nodes.description: Phase 0: Foundation; Phase 1: Connection; Phase 2: Models; Phase 3: Query/CRUD; Phase 4: Associations; Phase 5: Transactions+Hooks; Phase 6: Migrations; Phase 7: Native SQL; Phase 8: Testing+Docs; Phase 9: Build+Publish

nodes.label: Mandatory Development Rules
nodes.description: No code without phase approval; No deps until Phase 0; TDD; Document decisions in DECISIONS.md; Update WORKLOG.md; Coverage > 85%; ESM+CJS compat; Mandatory parameterization

nodes.label: Driver Selection: node-firebird
nodes.description: Use node-firebird (hgourvest) as primary driver - pure JS, zero native deps, wire protocol, active maintenance, production-validated

nodes.label: Adapter Pattern for Drivers
nodes.description: Core ORM does not depend directly on node-firebird; IDriverAdapter interface abstracts connect, pool, execute, transactions; allows future NativeDriverAdapter

nodes.label: Supported Versions: Node ≥18 LTS, Firebird 3.0+
nodes.description: Node.js 18+ LTS (ESM native, fetch, crypto); Firebird 3.0+ full support (4.0/5.0); 2.5 best-effort; auto-detect version on connect

nodes.label: Primary Key Strategy: Auto-detect IDENTITY/Generator
nodes.description: Auto-detect IDENTITY columns (FB4+) else Generator+Trigger (FB2.5/3); RETURNING clause for FB2.1+

nodes.label: Mandatory Parameterization
nodes.description: Zero SQL concatenation - all queries must use parameterized statements

nodes.label: Unified Pagination API
nodes.description: Unified pagination API with SQL adapted per Firebird version (SKIP/FETCH for FB4+, ROWS for FB3, legacy for FB2.5)

nodes.label: DECIMAL/NUMERIC as String
nodes.description: Return DECIMAL/NUMERIC as strings in JavaScript to preserve exact precision

nodes.label: Dual ESM/CJS Build with .d.ts
nodes.description: Build outputs both ESM and CJS formats plus TypeScript declarations

nodes.label: Unit + Integration Testing
nodes.description: Unit tests with mocks; Integration tests with real Firebird via Docker (3.0/4.0/5.0 matrix)

nodes.label: Sequelize
nodes.description: Main entry point class - constructor(config), define(name, attributes, options), authenticate(), sync(), transaction(), close()

nodes.label: Model
nodes.description: Base model class - static methods: findByPk, findAll, findOne, create, bulkCreate, destroy, update; instance methods: save, destroy, reload

nodes.label: DataTypes
nodes.description: Firebird type mappings: STRING, INTEGER, BIGINT, FLOAT, DOUBLE, DECIMAL, DATE, DATEONLY, TIME, BOOLEAN, BLOB, TEXT, UUID, ENUM, ARRAY, JSON

nodes.label: Association Types
nodes.description: HasMany, BelongsTo, HasOne, BelongsToMany - defined via Model.associate() or sequelize.define options

nodes.label: Op (Operators)
nodes.description: Query operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in, notIn, between, notBetween, isNull, notNull, and, or, not

nodes.label: fn, col, literal
nodes.description: SQL functions (fn), column references (col), raw literals (literal) for query building

nodes.label: Transaction
nodes.description: Managed transactions with isolation levels, savepoints, auto-commit/rollback

nodes.label: Migrator / Migration
nodes.description: Programmatic migration API + CLI commands: migration:create, migration:up, migration:down

nodes.label: ValidationError, DatabaseError
nodes.description: Structured error classes for validation and database errors

nodes.label: node-firebird
nodes.description: Pure JavaScript Firebird driver (~100k weekly downloads), wire protocol, no native deps, supports FB 2.5-5.0

nodes.label: node-firebird-driver
nodes.description: Official Firebird driver project - TypeScript interfaces only, not complete implementation, requires fbclient.dll

nodes.label: node-firebird-driver-native
nodes.description: Native binding to Firebird client library, better performance but requires compilation, complex deployment

nodes.description: Container runtime for Firebird integration testing matrix (3.0, 4.0, 5.0)
